title: Parent Portal Orientation and Account Safety
short_description: Learn how parents and guardians sign in, confirm linked children, protect access, receive notices, and request corrections safely.

steps.title: Activate your parent account safely
steps.description: Use the invitation sent to your verified email or phone and create a private password.

steps.title: Confirm every linked child
steps.description: Check each child’s name, school, branch, class and relationship before using the portal.

steps.title: Review contact and notification preferences
steps.description: Confirm the phone number, email and approved notification channels used by the school.

steps.title: Learn the parent support route
steps.description: Report missing children, duplicate links or wrong records to the school instead of creating another account.

title: Parent Portal Daily Use
short_description: Review attendance, approved results, report cards, fees, school notices, pickup permissions and support requests for linked children.

steps.title: Select the correct child
steps.description: Always confirm the child and branch before reviewing records or giving an instruction.

steps.title: Review attendance and approved outcomes
steps.description: Use published attendance, results and report cards and follow the school’s review process for questions.

steps.title: Review fees, receipts and school notices
steps.description: Confirm references and payment status; never send money to an unverified personal account.

steps.title: Manage pickup permissions and support requests
steps.description: Authorise pickup persons carefully and report urgent safety or data issues through the approved channel.

title: Registrar Admissions and Applicant Records
short_description: Publish branch-specific admission windows, review applications, prevent duplicates and maintain reliable applicant evidence.

steps.title: Confirm branch, session and programme offerings
steps.description: Do not publish an admission until the campus and valid programme offerings are ready.

steps.title: Review applicant identity and evidence
steps.description: Check names, contacts, previous school details and attachments before deciding.

steps.title: Prevent duplicate applicant and student records
steps.description: Search existing records and escalate uncertain matches instead of creating another identity.

steps.title: Record the decision and handoff
steps.description: Use approved, rejected or enrolled states consistently and preserve the decision evidence.

title: Student Enrolment, Transfers and Record Lifecycle
short_description: Create and maintain student records, guardians, programme enrolment, transfers, withdrawals and document requests safely.

steps.title: Create the student from an approved source
steps.description: Convert an approved applicant or verify the source record before creating a student manually.

steps.title: Link verified parents and guardians
steps.description: Confirm relationship, contact details, pickup authority and portal user mapping.

steps.title: Maintain programme and class history
steps.description: Use effective dates and approved transfers instead of overwriting historical placement.

steps.title: Process exits and document requests
steps.description: Record withdrawal, graduation or transfer evidence and release documents only through authorised approval.

title: Bursary Fees, Receipts and Student Accounts
short_description: Manage fee structures, billed amounts, receipts, allocations, discounts and outstanding balances without weakening accounting truth.

steps.title: Review fee setup and accounting defaults
steps.description: Confirm company, branch, receivable, income, discount and write-off accounts before billing.

steps.title: Create or review the correct student billing
steps.description: Check student, period, branch and components before submission; never mutate submitted accounting records.

steps.title: Record and allocate the payment
steps.description: Use the correct bank or cash account, reference, date and invoice allocation.

steps.title: Issue and verify the receipt
steps.description: Confirm the submitted payment, outstanding balance and payer reference before sharing a receipt.

title: Bank Reconciliation, Payables and Financial Reporting
short_description: Reconcile collections, manage expenses and suppliers, review receivables and produce branch-aware accounting reports.

steps.title: Reconcile bank and cash collections
steps.description: Match statements and receipts, investigate differences and avoid duplicate allocations.

steps.title: Process school expenses and supplier invoices
steps.description: Use approved suppliers, expense accounts, cost centres and supporting documents.

steps.title: Review receivables and payables
steps.description: Use ageing reports and source documents before following up or approving payment.

steps.title: Prepare management and statutory reports
steps.description: Use company, branch, date and accounting-period filters and explain unresolved reconciliation items.

title: HR Staff Records and Onboarding
short_description: Maintain employee identity, employment details, branch assignments, onboarding evidence and role handoffs.

steps.title: Create a verified employee record
steps.description: Confirm identity, contact, department, designation, company and employment dates.

steps.title: Coordinate school roles and branch access
steps.description: HR records employment; authorised administrators grant system roles and campus access separately.

steps.title: Complete onboarding and policy acknowledgement
steps.description: Record required documents, orientation, safeguarding and role-specific training.

steps.title: Protect confidential staff information
steps.description: Share personal, disciplinary and payroll data only with authorised roles.

title: HR Leave, Attendance and Payroll Operations
short_description: Operate staff attendance, leave, payroll review and separation workflows with proper approval and confidentiality.

steps.title: Maintain leave rules and approvals
steps.description: Confirm leave types, allocations, approvers and effective periods before processing requests.

steps.title: Review staff attendance exceptions
steps.description: Resolve missing punches, approved absences and branch assignments before payroll.

steps.title: Prepare and review payroll
steps.description: Check salary structures, deductions, taxes, bank details and approval evidence before submission.

steps.title: Process transfers, exits and final handoff
steps.description: Preserve employment history, revoke access promptly and complete final payroll and asset clearance.

title: School Procurement and Supplier Workflow
short_description: Raise approved requests, obtain purchasing approval, receive supplies and hand invoices to Accounts with complete evidence.

steps.title: Raise a justified material request
steps.description: Select the correct branch, purpose, required date, items and quantities.

steps.title: Obtain purchase approval
steps.description: Use approved suppliers, price evidence and delegated authority before ordering.

steps.title: Receive and inspect supplies
steps.description: Verify quantity, condition, warehouse and supporting delivery documents before receipt.

steps.title: Hand the supplier invoice to Accounts
steps.description: Match order, receipt and invoice and explain any variance before payment processing.

title: Stores, Inventory and School Asset Control
short_description: Control school stock, issue materials, count inventory, register assets and preserve custody and maintenance evidence.

steps.title: Confirm warehouse and branch ownership
steps.description: Do not mix stock from unrelated campuses or warehouses.

steps.title: Receive, issue and transfer stock correctly
steps.description: Use the appropriate stock movement and record the receiving person or destination.

steps.title: Perform controlled stock counts
steps.description: Count independently, investigate variances and post approved adjustments only.

steps.title: Register and track school assets
steps.description: Record location, custodian, value, maintenance and disposal approval.

title: Daily School Operations and Service Coordination
short_description: Coordinate branches, facilities, calendars, communications, incidents and operational handoffs without bypassing specialist owners.

steps.title: Review daily branch readiness
steps.description: Check timetable, staffing, rooms, transport, safety, utilities and unresolved incidents.

steps.title: Coordinate responsible service owners
steps.description: Assign clear owners and deadlines instead of changing specialist records without authority.

steps.title: Send approved notices
steps.description: Use verified recipient groups, approved templates and the correct branch context.

steps.title: Close operational exceptions with evidence
steps.description: Record outcome, responsible person, time and escalation for unresolved issues.

title: School Management Approvals, Reports and Audit Follow-up
short_description: Review operational reports, approve within delegated authority and follow up audit, safety, finance and academic exceptions.

steps.title: Review source records before approval
steps.description: Open the underlying document, branch, date and evidence rather than approving from a summary alone.

steps.title: Apply delegated authority
steps.description: Approve only within your role and route higher-value or sensitive decisions correctly.

steps.title: Review cross-functional reports
steps.description: Compare academics, attendance, finance, safety, staffing and operations using consistent filters.

steps.title: Track corrective actions to closure
steps.description: Assign owners, due dates and evidence and retain an audit trail of the resolution.

title: CBT Invigilation, Offline Resilience and Pending Sync
short_description: Prepare the examination room, verify candidates, monitor integrity, handle network loss and resolve pending answer sync safely.

steps.title: Prepare the examination room
steps.description: Confirm devices, browser, power, network, seating and authorised candidate list.

steps.title: Verify each candidate and attempt
steps.description: Allow one correct active attempt per eligible student and prevent account sharing.

steps.title: Monitor integrity and network state
steps.description: Record focus violations, incidents and offline status without interrupting valid local answer saving.

steps.title: Resolve pending sync before result approval
steps.description: Keep affected students visible and block approval until all pending answers are resolved or formally handled.

title: Student Safety, Pickup and Incident Control
short_description: Verify release authority, manage school-bus handoffs, record incidents and maintain a complete student release audit trail.

steps.title: Confirm the approved release mode
steps.description: Verify parent pickup, authorised person, school bus, staff escort, emergency pickup or approved self-exit.

steps.title: Verify the person, vehicle or route
steps.description: Check identity, relationship, bus, driver, attendant, gate and branch context.

steps.title: Record boarding, release or drop-off
steps.description: Capture time, responsible staff and confirmation before closing the handoff.

steps.title: Escalate and document incidents
steps.description: Do not release a student when authority is uncertain; record the incident and notify authorised contacts.
